lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis preet sabad saachai har sar vaasaa paavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sadaa bag mailaa haumai mal laaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: isanaan karai par mail na jaaee ||
lines.translation: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai gurasabad beechaarai haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is rid of this filth of ego. ||6||
The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,
when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad mitiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ghat chaanan aap pachhaananiaa ||7||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come to recognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||
The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.
Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghat a(n)tar gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||8||31||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained. ||8||31||32||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa boojhai chauthai pad liv laavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree maaiaa mohu sabad jalaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotional attachment to Maya, through the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu jalaae so har siu chit laae har dar mahalee sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on the Lord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.
For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh pasariaa sa(n)saare aai jaai dukh paavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich giaan ratan ik paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.
By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam sach kamaavai gur poorai naam dhiaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from the Perfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.
Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat dovai gavaae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not find peace. ||4||
The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,
by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: pir kai sahaj rahai ra(n)g raatee sabad si(n)gaar banaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||
Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;
through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: eko rav rahiaa ghat a(n)tar mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur na seve so kaahe aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?
Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh naam chit na aavai bin naavai bahu dukh paavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.
He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam miliaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaavaniaa ||8||1||32||33||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33||
Maajh, Fourth Mehl:
The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.
He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi varatai eko soee guramukh sobhaa paavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree nira(n)kaaree naam dhiaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.
